name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza hospital strike 11 Nov; Yemen–Saudi strikes
summary: An Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed 6 on 11 Nov; Houthi–Saudi cross-border strikes continue in Yemen
state: Gaza health authorities said an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed six people, including a surgeon, on 11 Nov, despite the ceasefire (NPR, 12 Nov; Al Jazeera). In Yemen, the Saudi-led coalition said it shot down a Houthi ballistic missile over the Riyadh region, and Houthi media said strikes north of Sanaa killed 27, as the government's coalition-backed offensive continued (Al Jazeera, 7 Nov). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front set the Alert.
for_you: UK travellers should check FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes (Alert): Houthi missiles at Riyadh and coalition strikes in Yemen; Gaza ceasefire repeatedly violated
